rules.title: PharmaGo: tasa de errores HTTP 5xx
rules.query: 100 * sum by (service_name) (rate(pharmago_http_requests_total{job="otlp-collector", status_code=~"5..", endpoint!~"/health.*"}[1m])) / sum by (service_name) (rate(pharmago_http_requests_total{job="otlp-collector", endpoint!~"/health.*"}[1m])) and on (service_name) (sum by (service_name) (rate(pharmago_http_requests_total{job="otlp-collector", endpoint!~"/health.*"}[1m])) > 0.1)

rules.title: PharmaGo: latencia p95 HTTP alta
rules.query: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (service_name, le) (rate(pharmago_http_request_duration_milliseconds_bucket{job="otlp-collector", endpoint!~"/health.*"}[1m]))) and on (service_name) (sum by (service_name) (rate(pharmago_http_requests_total{job="otlp-collector", endpoint!~"/health.*"}[1m])) > 0.1)

rules.title: PharmaGo: CPU de Pod cerca del límite
rules.query: 100 * sum by (pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{job="kubernetes-cadvisor", namespace="pharmago", pod!="", container=""}[1m])) / sum by (pod) ((container_spec_cpu_quota{job="kubernetes-cadvisor", namespace="pharmago", pod!="", container=""} > 0) / container_spec_cpu_period{job="kubernetes-cadvisor", namespace="pharmago", pod!="", container=""})

rules.title: PharmaGo: memoria de Pod cerca del límite
rules.query: 100 * max by (pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{job="kubernetes-cadvisor", namespace="pharmago", pod!="", container=""}) / max by (pod) (container_spec_memory_limit_bytes{job="kubernetes-cadvisor", namespace="pharmago", pod!="", container=""} > 0)

rules.title: PharmaGo: Pod Running sin condición Ready
rules.query: max by (pod) (kube_pod_status_ready{job="kube-state-metrics", namespace="pharmago", condition="false"}) * on (pod) max by (pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{job="kube-state-metrics", namespace="pharmago", phase="Running"})
